name: stock.storages

description.en: Named storages per venue (P12, W-STORE): kitchen, bar and freezer built in, more named by the owner; a storage is renamed or archived (never deleted, refused while it holds stock). A transfer {item, qty, from, to} is a NOTE on the stock log: it never makes or destroys stock (ledger, cost, lots, carry and old checkpoints byte-equal); per-storage levels are a fold of each record's on_hand delta into the record's `store` key, else the storage that last received the item (Poster's rule), else kitchen -- so the storages always sum to onHand. Every record written before storages is the kitchen's. A delivery, write-off, prep or count may name its storage (`store`); a count in one storage tells the shelf that storage plus every other one. Read back in GET /api/owner/stock: `storages` and each supply's `byStore {stores, home}`. W-STORE2 (1.1.0): a kitchen station (kitchen, sushi, bar -- the dish's `station`) may be BOUND to a storage: POST /api/owner/stock/bound {station, store} (store "" unbinds), a note on the stock log; an unknown or archived storage is a 400 naming it, and a bound storage cannot be archived (409). A dish of a bound station draws (reserved->consumed, and the till's served) from that storage, split by what each dish used when one order mixes stations; an unbound venue writes byte-identical records (no `drawn` key). Lack of stock is decided on the whole shelf as before; a bound storage short of stock goes negative there, never falling through. Read back: storages[].stations (present only on a storage a station is bound to, so an unbound venue's answer keeps its bytes). An amended room round (released and reserved again) follows the same bindings (operator 2026-10-05).
description.uk: Склади закладу (кухня, бар, морозильник і свої): переміщення ніколи не створює і не знищує залишок; залишок по складах — згортка журналу, старі образи без змін. 1.1.0: станцію (кухня/суші/бар) можна прив'язати до складу — її страви списуються з нього; без прив'язки все як раніше.

producer.what: run(): kinds storage / moved -> dowiz_hub StockLog::put_storage / move_stock (crates/dowiz-hub/src/stock/storages.rs); W-STORE2: kind bound -> storages/bind.rs run() -> StockLog::bind_station (crates/dowiz-hub/src/stock/storages/bind.rs); draws: carry.rs commit_drawn writes `drawn`

consumer.what: open(): storage filter, per-storage rows, Move sheet (openMove line 47), count of one storage, storage cards; ingredients.js openMove sends `store` and `treated`; W-STORE2: stationsRow() (Stations row per storage, bind/unbind)

transport.body: ... plus store?: <storage id>, received also treated?: <paper no.>
